figures.alt: Kitchen sink cabinet with drain piping, garbage-disposal body, and accessible shutoff valves
figures.caption: Confirm the sink flange, cabinet clearance, drain configuration, electrical connection, and dishwasher discharge before ordering a disposal. The appliance has to fit the plumbing and the available service space.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Underside of a kitchen counter showing sink support clips and a clean drain opening
figures.caption: Support the sink and loosen the mounting ring carefully. A disposal is heavy, and disturbing a sink support or seal can create a leak at the opening above it.

figures.alt: Stainless kitchen sink seated in a clean countertop with faucet opening and drain basket
figures.caption: After wiring and drain connections are restored, run water through every joint and inspect the flange, trap, dishwasher inlet, and discharge for seepage before closing the cabinet.
